jobs.details: Civilian Direct Recruitment Board, ASC Centre (South) Bangalore invites offline applications for 62 Group C posts: Fireman (24), Leading Fireman (14), Tradesman (08), Civilian Motor Driver (06), Civilian Catering Instructor (03), Fire Engine Driver (03), Cook (02), Cleaner (02) and MTS (01). Selection is through PET/PST, Trade Test, Written Test, Document Verification and Medical Examination.
